# AMC Form Progress

<!-- Generated by tools/build-templates.mjs from template.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

**Region Template** for Universal Theme · direction: living · APEX 23.1+ · v1.0.0

A form frame whose top edge is a segmented meter with one segment per required item, and whose header says honestly how many required fields are done and offers a Next button to the next empty one.

**Use it for:** Form regions and Static Content regions with page items, especially long data-entry forms such as supplier registration, customer onboarding or claims. Around a report, chart or text it is a plain frame.

## Install

- **APEX 23.1 to 25.x (or any version, through the Builder):** App Builder > your app > Shared Components >
  Export/Import > Import `dist/legacy/amc_tpl_form_progress.sql` (Component Export). It creates the
  template in Universal Theme and its Static Application File(s) in `amc-templates/`.
- **APEX 26.1+ (APEXlang):** copy `dist/apexlang/shared-components/themes/universal-theme/region-templates/amc-form-progress.apx` and
  `dist/apexlang/shared-components/static-files/amc-templates/` into the app, add the entries from
  `dist/apexlang/static-files.snippet.apx` to `shared-components/static-files.apx`, then run the apexlang gates.

## Use

On any region, set **Appearance > Template** to **AMC Form Progress**. In APEXlang: `appearance { template: @amc-form-progress }`.

Living region template for forms. Design principles: Zeigarnik effect, used honestly: an open task stays in mind, so the frame shows a finite, visible distance to completion; only required items count and nothing is faked, so the meter never promises more than the form asks. Form design: the next empty required field is one click away, and with the Mark optional fields option the optional items are labelled instead of the required ones. How it works: the script finds the items in the region body by Universal Theme markup and treats an item as required when its field container has is-required, its control has required or aria-required="true", or its label carries a required marker: a visually hidden text containing (Value Required), a .t-Form-required element or a trailing asterisk. Hidden, disabled and conditionally not rendered items do not count. An item is filled when apex.item(id).isEmpty() is false, or, without the API, when its control has a value or a checked option. The header shows "4 of 7 required fields done" and a Next button naming the next empty required item after the focused one; a click on a meter segment focuses that item. When the last one is filled the segments turn to the success color one after another and the text reads "All 7 required fields done". The count is announced politely through a status region after each completed edit (change or leaving a field), never on every keystroke. It recalculates after apexafterrefresh, when Dynamic Actions show or hide items, and when values change. Forms with more than 24 required items get a continuous bar. English strings to translate, on the section element in the template or per region as Custom Attributes: data-amc-label-count %0 of %1 required fields done, data-amc-label-done All %0 required fields done, data-amc-label-next Next: %0, data-amc-label-draft Save a draft now and finish the rest later., data-amc-label-optional Optional, data-amc-label-filled filled, data-amc-label-empty still empty, data-amc-required-marker Value Required (the text of the hidden required marker in your language). Keyboard: the Next button is a real button in the header; segments are a pointer shortcut and hidden from assistive technology because the count and the button carry the same information. Reduced motion: no color sweep or transitions. Forced colors: segments use Highlight. JavaScript API: amcTplFormProgress.refresh(element) and result(element) returning total, done and the items.

## Template options

| Option | Class | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| Show save-draft hint | `amc-TFormProgress--draftHint` | While the form is started but not complete, a short line under the header says a draft can be saved and finished later. Use it only when the page really has a Save draft button or autosave. |
| Mark optional fields | `amc-TFormProgress--markOptional` | Adds a quiet Optional tag to the label of every visible item that is not required, for forms where most fields are required. |
| Sticky progress header | `amc-TFormProgress--sticky` | The meter and header stay at the top of the viewport while a long form scrolls. Set --amc-tfp-sticky-top on the page when a fixed page header covers it. |
| Continuous bar | `amc-TFormProgress--bar` | One continuous bar instead of one segment per item. Used automatically when the form has more than 24 required items. |
| No body padding | `amc-TFormProgress--noPadding` | Removes side padding around the items, for forms that bring their own spacing. |
